{{Top|leg}}
The '''holozoetroscope''' was a powerful [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] generator that produced highly realistic images. The device was a large cylinder that spun on its gyroscopic axis and projected different images across the room that it was situated in. The holozoetroscope was highly valued, and so was often seen only in the most high class establishments on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. However, the [[Arcade Omicron]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]] had somehow acquired one of these as the centerpiece to its main halllway. During [[Operation Death-Hunter]], the holozoetroscope present in this cantina was busy projecting an image of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], showing the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] being destroyed while [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] fought around the giant space station. At the same time, the device was also projecting images of famous sculptures and noted works of arts across the establishment.
